dataset_info.title: Multi-Region IoT Weather & Anomaly Scenarios Dataset
dataset_info.description: Realistic high-frequency sensor readings capturing ambient conditions and weather transition events.

normal_summer.behavior: Mild diurnal variation with light breeze.

tropical_typhoon_approach.behavior: Sharp barometric pressure drop (-4.5 hPa/hr), heavy downpour, high wind gusts up to 28 m/s.

extreme_heatwave.behavior: Extreme Heat Index exceeding 46°C, hazardous UV radiation, severe urban heat island trap.

mountain_cold_front.behavior: Dense fog, near-freezing mountain frost risk, high wind chill factor.
